strings: m_c's nightmares have always been worse than other cats, and they never seem to go away.
It seems to r_c like every night m_c is having a nightmare.

after m_c comes into r_c's den in the middle of the night, whimpering about {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nightmares yet again, r_c tells {PRONOUN/m_c/object} that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} may have chronic nightmares.
